item.title: The MIMIC-III-Ext-PPG dataset
item.description: A new dataset, named MIMIC-III-Ext-PPG, has recently been released. It is a benchmark dataset designed for developing and testing PPG models and algorithms. The dataset contains 4.9 million 30-second segments of PPG signals, alongside heart rhythm labels and reference parameters such as heart rate, blood pressure, and respiratory rate. The data were extracted from the larger MIMIC-III dataset, which was collected from critically-ill patients in hospital. It also contains other simultaneous physiological signals, such as ECG and invasive blood pressure signals.

item.title: A PPG-derived aging clock
item.description:
Researchers at Apple developed a method to predict age from Apple Watch PPG signals. Key findings included:

  • The model could predict age accurately.
  • The difference between predicted age and actual age was associated with current diseases, future diseases, smoking and exercise habits, and more.
  • Predicted age changed over time during pregnancy.

Read the paper here.

item.title: Skin tone and pulse oximetry
item.description:
Recent research by Daniel Martin and colleagues, published in The BMJ, examined how skin tone affects the accuracy of pulse oximeters used in the NHS COVID Oximetry @home programme.

By comparing readings from commonly used pulse oximeters with gold-standard arterial blood gas measurements, the study found that the pulse oximeters overestimated blood oxygen saturation (SpO₂) when the true oxygen saturation was low, and underestimated SpO2 when the true oxygen saturation was high. The authors conclude that this “could translate into potentially clinically important differences in false negative and false positive rates for detecting hypoxaemia”.

item.title: Data
item.description:
Dataset Catalog

open-PPG provides a catalog of datasets containing photoplethysmography (PPG) signals. The catalog provides a list of many publicly available datasets, as well as some restricted access datasets that can be used in research. The list of datasets can be filtered to identify datasets that match your needs.

PPG Dataset Catalog

Contributing
